verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no dedicated 'skills' feature. The closest mechanisms are MCP servers configured in ~/.gemini/settings.json to add custom tools and capabilities (e.g. media generation), plus GEMINI.md context files to tailor behavior. One community report says GEMINI.md is ignored in practice, which weakens the context-file route. Missing for 10: a documented first-class skills mechanism (packaged instructions/resources loaded on demand), skill authoring docs, and independent confirmation that custom tools reliably drive specialized tasks.
